files.description: Big-step evaluation of a small arithmetic language (numerals, addition, predecessor) is deterministic.
files.shape: case on first derivation + inversion on second; one inductive call per subterm plus add_det/prd_det functionality lemmas; no schema, closed context

files.description: A mirror-convertibility relation on binary trees (congruence + child-flip) is symmetric.
files.shape: case over 4 constructors, 2 base + 2 congruence recursions (flip swaps subproofs)

files.description: A right-nested reflexive-transitive closure over a two-form step relation on worlds is transitive.
files.shape: induct on second derivation; refl returns first arg, snoc recurses then re-snocs

files.description: A binder-free typed calculus (naturals, booleans, pairs) has small-step type preservation.
files.shape: invert the typing derivation, six base reductions, five congruence recursions; no binders/schema

files.description: A weakening/subsumption lemma: a typing derivation transports along a weakening substitution between related contexts.
files.shape: schema-block context with a substitution variable $W, parameter #p.2 case, inductive calls under the t_lam binder extending both contexts and the substitution
